games.name: Endless Nightmare
games.description: First-person horror hide & seek: hide in a dark house while It hunts you down. 1-8 players.
games.notes:
Host: open the game, click HOST A GAME, and send everyone the 5-letter room code.
Friends: type the code and click JOIN.
When everyone is in the lobby, the host clicks BEGIN.
Everyone needs the same version and an internet connection. Chrome or Edge work best.
Alone? Click PLAY SOLO and a bot hunts you.
